_comment: Copy to bridge.config.json and edit. Delete the keys you do not use.
_tcp: Network printer. Most Epson TM and Xprinter models with an Ethernet port. Find the IP by holding FEED while powering on - it prints its own settings.
_share: Windows USB printer. Install its driver, then Printer properties > Sharing > Share this printer, name it POS80 (no spaces).
_token: Must match NEXT_PUBLIC_PRINT_BRIDGE_TOKEN in the app. Stops a stray web page opening the cash drawer.
_origins: Which web origins may print. Add your Vercel URL.
